label: Now Developing
items: House prosecutors filed their unexplained-wealth evidence in the Sara Duterte trial; the Ombudsman said it will review what they turn over.
The Supreme Court voided the 2024 and 2025 budgets, and DILG posted a ₱50-million bounty for Senator Bato dela Rosa.
Manila completed an Ayungin resupply and rejected China's permission claim, while the first OFWs stranded in Saudi Arabia came home.
